Opt ani mai tacirc;rziu, visul ei este aproape să devină realitate, cacirc;nd prințul Alexei Frederick Berthold Ruprecht Pruzinsky, moștenitorul Regatului Avaloniei, iși manifestă deschis interesul pentru uluitor de frumoasa domnișoară. Dar intacirc;lnirea secretă cu prințul, in timpul căreia Jocelyn speră că va fi cerută de soție, este intreruptă in mod neașteptat cacirc;nd se trezește in mijlocul unui complot care ii pune viața in pericol. Singura soluție este să o ducă departe de Londra, iar pentru a-i proteja reputația este de acord să se căsătorească imediat cu ea, chiar dacă o consideră departe de idealul său de soție. # Bride for a Prince: A Tale of Royal Intrigue

Are you captivated by the romance of fairy tales? For Lady Jocelyn, the line between dream and reality was constantly blurred. In this sweeping historical novel, *Bride for a Prince*, readers are drawn into a world where ancient desires meet dangerous royal secrets. This enchanting story from Litera promises an escape into high society, forbidden passion, and battles for destiny.

***

## Discover the World of Lady Jocelyn

Lady Jocelyn has longed since childhood to be a princessâa life filled with grandeur, romance, and the perfect marriage to a noble prince within a magnificent castle. Eight years after her deepest wishes were whispered to the stars, her dream seems poised to come true.

The handsome Prince Alexei Frederick Berthold Ruprecht Pruzinsky, heir to the Kingdom of Avalonia, shows an undeniable interest in the lovely Lady Jocelyn. Their initial secret meetings are filled with breathless hope and anticipationâa courtship that promises a lifetime together.

However, fate intervenes when their private moments are shattered by a conspiracy, plunging Jocelyn into unimaginable danger and forcing her survival skills to the forefront.

### Secrets, Sacrifice, and Unexpected Love

When peril strikes, salvation arrives in the form of Viscount Rand de Beaumont. A daring man serving the King, Rand vows to protect Jocelyn at any cost. To keep her safe and shield her reputation from scandal, he makes a shocking decision: he must marry her immediately, even though she falls far short of his ideal vision for a wife.

Underneath Jocelyn's independent spirit and seemingly carefree demeanor lies a hidden vulnerability and a passion that slowly captivates Rand. The growing love between them is beautiful, yet it is constantly threatened by the greatest secret of allâa truth about Rand himself that could shatter her trust forever.

To be truly worthy of royalty, both heart and mind must be pure. Can Jocelyn discover if the man she loves deserves to be a prince, or will his deepest secrets force her to question everything?
